== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Navigator]]’s [[Guild]] is an [[Imperial]] organization that holds a monopoly on safe travel across the [[Aion Sea]]. Because they are the only force capable of crossing these waters at will, its members often accumulate significant personal wealth. [[The Guild]] is currently led by [[Cheska Bennett]], who commands the flagship known as [[The Eternal]], a blood-red vessel that leaves trails of alchemical fire in its wake. [[The Guild]]'s maritime dominance is rooted in a unique technological and mystical secret: their ships, known as [[Vessels]], are one-of-a-kind [[Awakened objects]]. These vessels are constructed by integrating parts of an Elder into the ship's structure, allowing them to navigate the dangerous sea. Furthermore, Navigators are believed to be [[Soulbound]] to their ships, granting them an uncanny ability to control their vessels as if they were part of their own bodies. This connection allows for incredibly small crews, as the Captain maintains direct control over the ship. While some view them as essential for commerce and travel, others characterize the members as pirates or con artists. [[The Guild]] maintains a massive presence throughout [[The Empire|the Empire]], possessing properties and fleets used for various business ventures. Their headquarters in the Capital is a large structure built from the remains of ancient ships, featuring masts and portholes. Despite their specialized role, they are involved in broader [[Imperial]] politics, often working alongside or in tension with other groups like the [[Blackwatch]], the [[Consultants]], and the [[Magisters]].}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|As one of the established groups residing on the [[Gray Island]], the [[Navigator]]’s [[Guild]] operates as an organization composed of captains and various members who enjoy discounts at alchemical chapter houses. The guild maintains [[Authority|authority]] over individuals such as [[Andel Petronus]] and possesses the capacity to be loaded with soldiers and [[Guards]]. Their operations involve various contracts, including a job provided to [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]], who was eventually sentenced to perform forced labor in the guild's service.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Navigator’s Guild]] supervises [[Andel Petronus]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c13">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Navigator’s Guild|Navigator's Guild]] is a group that can be loaded with soldiers and [[Guards]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c14">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Navigator’s Guild]] is one of the groups on the [[Gray Island]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c20">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 20</ref>}}</li>
